title: Sri Lanka in Serenity
highlights: Witness the spiritual heart of Kandy at this UNESCO-listed site, housing a sacred relic of the Buddha
Experience the vibrant traditions of Kandyan dance and music, unveiling the cultural tapestry of the region
Explore the quaint town of Nuwara Eliya, reminiscent of colonial times, adorned with charming architecture and cool mountain air
Glide along the tranquil Madhu River in Bentota and take in the vistas of lush mangroves and diverse birdlife
Navigate the bustling markets of Pettah and shop for an array of spices, textiles, and local crafts
Indulge in the diverse flavors of Sri Lankan cuisine, from street food to upscale dining experiences
Explore Colombo's modern skyline and historical landmarks, including Colombo Fort, Lotus Tower and World Trade Building
overview:
About the Tour:
Enjoy a splendid time exploring the teardrop-shaped jewel of the Indian Ocean – Sri Lanka. Have an unforgettable 6-day journey through the heart of Sri Lanka, where culture, nature, and coastal beauty converge to create a holistic travel experience. Dive into the city's vibrant history through a captivating cultural show, showcasing the rhythmic dance and music that echo the soul of Kandy. Traverse to Nuwara Eliya, nestled amidst verdant tea plantations, immersing yourself in the art of tea-making at local estates and gazing upon the breathtaking vistas. Unwind on pristine beaches or partake in thrilling water sports while discovering the natural splendor at Brief Garden or along the tranquil Bentota River. Conclude your journey in Colombo, a bustling metropolis steeped in history yet adorned with modernity. Dive into the city's vibrant markets, relish in tantalizing local cuisine, and explore iconic landmarks like Independence Square, encapsulating the dynamic blend of tradition and contemporary life in Sri Lanka's capital.
inclusions: Transfer from Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
1 night stay in Kandy with breakfast and lunch or dinner
1 night stay in Nuwara Eliya with breakfast
2 nights stay in Bentota with breakfast
1 night stay in Colombo with breakfast
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of arrival.
All foreign nationals must share their passport and visa details at the time of arrival.
All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.
Avoid using plastic bags and maintain the ecological balance of the destinations. Travelers littering may be fined.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Colombo to Kandy | Visit the Tooth Relic Temple
days.desc: Upon arrival, the representative will pick you up from the Bandaranaike International Airport and take you to your hotel in Kandy. On the way, visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage. Upon arrival in Kandy, visit the beautiful Tooth Relic Temple. Then, head to your hotel and check-in. In the evening, take in the panoramic views from the Kandy lake and enjoy an entertaining Kandyan Dance performance. After a fun day, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Kandy.

items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the Bandaranaike International Airport and take you to your pre-booked hotel in Kandy.
In the evening, the representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to Kandy Lake.
Afterwards, get transferred to enjoy the Kandyan Dance performance
After a fun-filled day, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Kandy.

items.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
items.desc:
Watch majestic elephants taking a bath in the Ma Oya River.
Take a leisurely stroll alongside the elephants as they amble through the lush grounds of the orphanage.
Learn about the conservation efforts, the history of the orphanage, and the challenges faced by Asian elephants in the wild.

items.title: Tooth Relic Temple
items.desc:
Immerse yourself in the deeply spiritual atmosphere by attending the daily puja ceremonies at the temple. 
Wander through the intricately adorned shrine rooms that house the revered relic of the tooth of the Buddha. 
Delve into the temple's rich history at the Temple Museum and explore exhibits showcasing artifacts, historical documents, and royal regalia.

items.title: Kandy Laka & Kandyan Dance Performance
items.desc:
Enjoy a leisurely stroll along the Kandy lakeside promenade and take in stunning views of the surrounding hills and the Temple of the Tooth.
Attend a traditional Kandyan dance performance and feel the rhythmic beats of traditional drums.
Marvel at the elaborate and colorful costumes worn by the dancers, each outfit representing a unique cultural story or character.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya | Welcome to the City of Lights
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Nuwara Eliya. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Nuwara Eliya. Visit the Tea plantation, Hanuman Temple, Ramboda Falls and Gregory Lake. Later, visit Hakgala Garden and Victoria Park. After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to your pre-booked hotel in Nuwara Eliya.
After check-in, the representative will take you on a sightseeing tour of Nuwara Eliya.
Post sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

items.title: Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Delight your senses with a tea-tasting session, savoring various brews and learning to distinguish flavors and aromas at Tea Plantation.
Visit the Hanuman Temple and take in the picturesque surroundings while learning about the temple's mythology and history.
Marvel at the breathtaking cascade of Ramboda Falls, one of Sri Lanka's most picturesque waterfalls. 
Enjoy a leisurely stroll at Gregory Lake and relax by the lakeside with scenic vistas.
Wander through the enchanting Hakgala Botanical Gardens, home to an exquisite collection of flora from around the world.
Explore the lush Victoria Park and walk through the verdant trails, spot various bird species, and admire the colorful blooms in this meticulously maintained urban park.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Bentota | City of Golden Beaches
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Bentota. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, get transferred to Madu River. You can enjoy a boat ride on the river. Enjoy a stroll around the river and take in the picturesque views of the surroundings. After exploration, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bentota.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to your pre-booked hotel in Bentota.
In the evening, the representative will take you to Madhu River for sightseeing.
After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bentota.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

items.title: Madu River
items.desc:
Take in the scenic vistas of the surroundings as you walk around the banks of the river.
You can enjoy a boat ride along the Madu River, immersing yourself in the serene beauty of mangrove-lined waterways.
Get a chance to spot diverse avian species that call the riverbanks and mangroves home.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

days.title: Bentota Sightseeing Tour | Visit the Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: After breakfast, the representative will pick you up and take you on a sightseeing tour of Bentota. Visit a Turtle Hatchery and see the conservation efforts dedicated to protecting endangered sea turtles. Then, explore a Cinnamon Plantation and sample a variety of spices, including cinnamon, nutmeg, and cardamom. Continue to a Fish Pedicure Center and enjoy a unique and natural spa treatment. Post sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bentota.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up and take you on a sightseeing tour of Bentota.
After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bentota.

items.title: Bentota Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Explore a Turtle Hatchery and learn about the different turtle species, their life cycles, and the challenges they face in the wild.
Visit a Cinnamon Plantation and see the harvesting of cinnamon bark, drying processes, and the art of creating various cinnamon products.
Enjoy a relaxing and rejuvenating fish pedicure at the Fish Pedicure Center.

days.title: Bentota To Colombo | The Commercial Capital of Sri Lanka
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Colombo. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, the representative will take you on a sightseeing tour of Colombo. Enjoy exploring Colombo Fort and Pettah Market, Lotus Tower, Lover’s Island, World Trade Building and many more. After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel. In the evening, you can visit the suspension bridge. Have an overnight stay in Colombo.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to your pre-booked hotel in Colombo.
After check-in, the representative will take you on a sightseeing tour of Colombo.
Post sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Colombo.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

items.title: Colombo Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Wander through the historic district of Fort and marvel at the colonial architecture and remnants of Dutch and British influence.
Explore the local culture at Pettah's markets, where you can shop for spices, textiles, and souvenirs. 
Marvel at the architectural splendor of the Lotus Tower and take in the panoramic views of the cityscape, the Indian Ocean, and the surrounding landscapes from the observation deck.
Enjoy a leisurely stroll along the shore of Lover's lsland and admire the picturesque views.
Visit the World Trade Building and admire the modern architecture and bustling commercial activities within this prominent business center.

days.title: Departure | Trip ends with plethora of memories
days.desc: After breakfast, pack your bags and check out from the hotel. The representative will pick you up and take you to Bandaranaike International Airport, where your trip comes to an end.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to Bandaranaike International Airport for your flight back home.
